logoPolicy: Original embedded PNG bytes, no redraw, recolor, crop or lockup. Preserve aspect ratio and clear space.
paletteAuthority: 2026 template: navy 1A2C55, blue 135894, orange F4911B, pale F6F7F8. Cheat sheet primary logo colors retained in original asset.
typeAuthority: Arial is the documented broadly available licensed-font fallback. No premium font redistributed.
microsoftBranding: Existing Microsoft product names remain as supplied text. No official Microsoft event logo supplied; no invented co-branded lockup or endorsement.

surfaceRecord.audience: Mixed business leaders, makers and developers at two independent Detroit conference talks on November 10, 2026.
surfaceRecord.purpose: Present a 60-minute Microsoft 365 Copilot, Cowork and Copilot Studio story, then a separate 30-minute Foundry decision/demo story.
surfaceRecord.visualSystem: AIS-branded visual-first conference presentation: documented Arial fallback, official navy/blue/orange, product journey, IQ map, synthetic brief/app specimens, theme edit, lifecycle and catalog-processing diagrams. One attributed app-runtime conference figure is excerpted; other conference insights are adapted into original scenario artwork. Text supports the visual; operational detail lives in the guide and private notes.
surfaceRecord.contentBoundary: The deck has 19 Talk A slides and 6 Talk B slides. Talk A retains its product launch. Talk B recaps that experience, explains why we add Foundry, contrasts platform highlights with the implemented hosted specialist, then centers a continuous lamp-catalog demo. Repeated pipeline, hypothetical review/export, SDK failure and benchmark slides are removed; optional engineering material remains in the guide. The lamp example does not depend on Talk A demo state. Speaker notes remain isolated in the private presenter console.
surfaceRecord.responsive: Projector-first at 1280x720 and 1920x1080; mobile is a scrollable reading view with controls after the active slide. Cover geometry is removed on narrow screens to protect text.
surfaceRecord.accessibility: Named AIS image group, keyboard navigation and focus retained, reduced-motion preference disables all navigation animation, inactive slides are inert, no premium/external font dependency, private notes remain inert templates and separate presenter console.
surfaceRecord.motion: On navigation only: interruptible 340ms directional sheet transition, 480ms chapter wipe and one 380ms artifact arrival with 70ms delay. No loops, extra clicks or hidden-content builds. Resize, print and reduced-motion changes cancel animations immediately. Prompt/code/diagram surfaces use restrained offset shadows; code is an AIS navy working surface.
surfaceRecord.print: Landscape, one slide per page, repeated original AIS mark and no presenter notes.
surfaceRecord.guide: Exactly one demo-only attendee-guide.html: M365 brief, Cowork app, IDE color edit, Studio governed lifecycle/model/web walkthrough and Foundry catalog processing. Foundry has a six-slide run sheet, continuous product walkthrough, exact Studio prompt and actual-result checks. FC-03 sources and hosted processor exist; review UI, export, tracing UI and measured comparison remain unbuilt. Debugging and evaluation design are optional references. index.html and private presenter.html are the only other HTML endpoints.
surfaceRecord.copyReview: Audience readiness asides removed, not hidden. Intrinsic synthetic/example labels and preview boundaries retained. Private notes and guide carry rehearsal, authorization and implementation status. Arial detector finding is intentional under the documented AIS brand authority; no design-hook suppression is configured.
surfaceRecord.unresolved: An approved Microsoft event-specific logo or event co-brand lockup was not supplied; none is invented.
